content.short: bunq is a European neobank with multi-currency accounts, cards, savings and investing in one app.
content.description: bunq, founded in 2012 in Amsterdam, is one of Europe's largest neobanks and holds a full European banking licence. Its app lets consumers and businesses open multi-currency accounts and sub-accounts, spend with physical and virtual cards, budget and save with automated tools, and invest in stocks and crypto alongside everyday banking. bunq offers free local IBANs in several countries, low-cost foreign exchange and travel features such as in-app eSIMs. Built mobile-first for people who live and work internationally, it brings personal finance, business banking and cross-border payments together in one platform.
